Write the proposal.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_yIoDGZsrztKusBcRr14X3130","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): Proof<Response, \"state_isolated\" | \"injection_safe\"> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"Idempotency-Key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing_idempotency_key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const child = call(\"greet\", { path: \"/greet\" });\n    return Response.text(child.body);\n  });\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":27401,"completion_tokens":565,"total_tokens":27966,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":27136},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":284},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":27136,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":265},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
